Available via LinIf.h ⌋ [SWS_LinIf_00356] ⌈The function LinTp_Shutdown shall close all pending transport protocol connection of the LIN TP and free all resources of the LIN TP.⌋ [SWS_LinIf_00433] ⌈The function LinTp_Shutdown shall affect all configured chan- nels.⌋ [SWS_LinIf_00484] ⌈The function LinTp_Shutdown shall set the LIN TP state of all channels to LINTP_UNINIT.⌋ [SWS_LinIf_00683] ⌈The function LinTp_Shutdown shall be pre-compile time con- figurable On/Off by the configuration parameter LinIfTpSupported.⌋ Caveats: The LIN Interface has to be initialized with a call of LinIf_Init and LinTp_Init before this API service may be called, see [SRS_BSW_00487].
